walkthroughs.body_html:
Sikhism Option — a core area of GCSE Religious Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Sikhism Option brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Sikhism Option.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How many Sikh Gurus were there?
Who do Sikhs consider their living guru today?
options: The Guru Granth Sahib — the Sikh scripture, declared the eternal guru by Guru Gobind Singh after the line of ten human gurus ended.
Sikhs consider the Dalai Lama their current guru.
Sikhs follow a current living guru as their leader.
Tawhid is the name of an Islamic prayer position.
